description: PROP-BILL-058 service boundary test (cross-cutting.test.ts lines 178-218) checks a hardcoded string array of method names for substrings like 'payjp_event' and 'impact_log'. This does not inspect the actual DbClient interface from shell/types.ts. If someone adds a payjp_events method to the DbClient interface, this test would still pass because it checks a static list, not the real type or implementation. The test is tautological -- it asserts properties of a constant array defined in the test itself.
